widget_mechanic: A single-select dropdown whose options are magnitude buckets (Over 1h / Over 10h / Over 100h; <50 / 50-200 / 200+). Agent must pick the correct bucket — not the first option, not the default, not a smaller-magnitude bucket.

source_inspiration.instruction: Pick a bestselling business audiobook in a target length bucket.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: Bucketed length filter — picked a wrong length tier from the Audible Length dropdown.
